searchText: <@280788802631630858> From UX perspective it would make sense to prevent it. The main culprit seems to be the transaction type overloading. The same transaction type is used for contract invocation and creating new contracts. The difference is just omitting some bytes. Thanks for the reply. Couldn't the check be made after the "contract creation" type has been selected? Or even revert at the end?
